end.parentNote: Sana practised the three forms of water and changes such as evaporation, condensation, freezing, and melting. They used the example of wet clothes drying and later explained that the water went into the air as invisible water vapour. At first, they described the water as disappearing, but corrected this later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Sana to identify one example each of evaporation, condensation, freezing, and melting.
